request.style: English, female solo voice, clear and gentle, acoustic guitar, cello, piano, light percussion, somber and reflective mood, 70 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
In days when the judges ruled the land
A famine emptied out the grain
A man left Bethlehem in Judah
Seeking bread in foreign plain
Elimelech took his wife Naomi
And two sons they called by name
Mahlon and Chilion went with him
Ephrathites from the holy place
They crossed into the country Moab
And settled down in alien space

[Chorus]
She was left without her husband
She was left without her two sons
The ten years passed in silence
The family bonds are undone

[Verse]
Elimelech died in Moab
Naomi stood alone that day
Her two sons remained beside her
In a land far from away
They married Moabite women
Orpah and Ruth by name
Living out their ten years there
In a strange and distant place

[Chorus]
She was left without her husband
She was left without her two sons
The ten years passed in silence
The family bonds are undone

[Bridge]
Then Mahlon and Chilion died
Leaving widows in the land
Naomi lost her children
In a moment, hand in hand

[Chorus]
She was left without her husband
She was left without her two sons
The ten years passed in silence
The family bonds are undone

[Outro]
Left without her husband
Left without her sons
